XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: AdBlue warning light, warning of start block within a certain number of kilometres

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Inadequate injection control unit software

• Action: Perform the software update of the injection control unit

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: Ensure that the starter battery is connected to a battery charger and that all electrical consumers in the vehicle are disconnected for the duration of the operation.
    Using a diagnostic tool, also check that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
